content.title: Reduce Network Energy Consumption by 50%
content.description: This proposal aims to implement energy-efficient consensus mechanisms to reduce the network's carbon footprint. Changes include: 1) Optimizing validator node requirements, 2) Implementing proof-of-stake improvements that reduce computational overhead, 3) Setting energy consumption targets for all network participants. This aligns with global sustainability goals and positions our network as environmentally responsible.

title: Reduce Network Energy Consumption by 50%
summary: Implement energy-efficient consensus to reduce carbon footprint
